title: Acceptance evaluator ends with no verdict when its captured evidence cursor expires mid-run
outcome: An acceptance evaluation started through termal_evaluate_acceptance either reads its captured evidence basis for the whole run, or ends with a concrete, retryable stale-basis result naming what changed. It never ends with no verdict because a captured evidence cursor expired, for example when a new note lands on the item mid-run.
acceptance: The cause is identified with file and line. Engram's notes-window continuation refuses with work_show_cursor_invalid when any record is appended to the item after its captured cut (Engram src/work_service/record_windows.rs:156, `cursor.total != index.len()`); it is not a time expiry. TermAl maps that read error to the attempt's terminal unfinished evidence read (src/acceptance_evidence_recovery.rs:208-210 and 770-778), after which every submission is refused (src/acceptance_evaluation_api.rs:1953-1955), so no verdict follows. The Engram twin is filed and cross-referenced.

A behavioural test drives an evaluation whose evidence cursor expires or is invalidated mid-run, for example by a note appended to the item, and shows a concrete retryable stale-basis result with its reason, or a completed verdict on the captured basis, never a no-verdict end. It fails before the fix. Time is injected, with no wall clock.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.

completion.summary:
An acceptance evaluator no longer ends with a bare "no verdict" when its captured Engram notes cursor is invalidated mid-run.

Cause:
- Engram refuses a show-window continuation with work_show_cursor_invalid once a record is appended after the cut (record_windows.rs:156).
- TermAl mapped every read error to a terminal unfinished read that refused every later submission.

Fix (src/acceptance_evidence_recovery.rs, acceptance_evaluation.rs, acceptance_evaluation_api.rs):
- That refusal, identified by its structured code from the CLI or a control reply, is now a retryable stale evidence basis.
- The read returns state "stale" with Engram's reason. No verdict is accepted from that attempt.
- The submission refusal and the fan-in line name the stale basis, and the current attempt's disposition comes before an earlier retired write.
- Other read errors keep their existing handling.

Evidence:
- Two behavioural tests with injected time.
- RED-2 and RED-3 failed on twins, as expected. GREEN-3 passed 23/23, and fmt passed.
- The FULL gate on DL560 C6 passed (test-a78d3a71).
- The review pair was clean after round 2.
- The pre-landing and post-landing evaluations passed.

The Engram twin is w-5bf9985acf09. Follow-ups: w-894094576407 (wording) and w-d91d39a56bcb (docs). Landed as a6ce484e; the install is pending until after Legal's window.
